frases: That swing is about to drop you on your back!
Hit like and follow. Flo hung this one in five minutes!
Two screw hooks into the porch ceiling. Easy!
Into the ceiling boards? Those aren't holding anything up.
And a screw hook only grips with its threads. Every swing pulls it a little looser.
Swinging adds force. Bounce a little, and it all lands on those threads.
Okay, okay. What's the right way?
Find the joist above the ceiling. Use an eye bolt that goes all the way through it.
Washer and nut on top. Now the wood carries the load, not the threads.
And use closed hooks or quick links, so the chain can't jump off.
Fine. I'll go find the joist.
Screw hooks, or through bolts? Team Norm or Team Flo?
Follow for more backyard builds that won't fail!
